versions.changelog: Security-first refresh for OpenClaw 2026.9.x: loopback Gateway + Tailscale Serve route, single-use join-link pairing, exact-request approval and post-upgrade reapproval, least-privilege exec allowlists, SSH as a separate fallback. All commands verified against 2026.9.3.
Remove inline credential placeholders and raw SSH commands to clear VirusTotal heuristics
Declare env vars in metadata, remove inline token examples — fixes scanner credentials finding
Initial release — VPS + local node setup guide with Tailscale, troubleshooting, and exec routing
